labels.desc: List of the names of the regions. There are 39 labels such that ``data.labels[i]`` corresponds to map ``i``.

maps.desc: Fullpath to nifti file containing the :term:`Probabilistic atlas` image (shape is equal to ``(40, 48, 35, 39)``).

networks.desc: List containing the names of the networks. There are 39 network names such that ``data.networks[i]`` is the network name of region ``i``.

region_coords.desc: Length-3 :obj:`tuple` ``data.region_coords[i]`` contains the coordinates ``(x, y, z)`` of region ``i`` in :term:`MNI` space.
